name: Additional Rights 4
definition: Information about additional rights that can be granted for a meeting.

AdditionalRight.name: Additional Right
AdditionalRight.definition: Specific rights granted to the shareholders that can be exercised at shareholders meetings, for example, the right to ask questions, the right to add items to the agenda or table draft resolutions.

AdditionalRightInformationURLAddress.name: Additional Right Information URL Address
AdditionalRightInformationURLAddress.definition: Address to use over the www (HTTP) service where additional information on specific rights granted to the shareholders can be found.

AdditionalRightDeadline.name: Additional Right Deadline
AdditionalRightDeadline.definition: Additional right granted to determine the date and time by which security holders can propose amendments or new resolutions. This deadline is set by an intermediary.

AdditionalRightMarketDeadline.name: Additional Right Market Deadline
AdditionalRightMarketDeadline.definition: Additional right granted to determine the date and time by which security holders can propose amendments or new resolutions. This deadline is set by the issuer.

AdditionalRightThreshold.name: Additional Right Threshold
AdditionalRightThreshold.definition: Additional right granted to specify the minimum stake in share capital or cash value or number of security holders required to table resolutions.
